messages:
Lena (Sales): Bluefin sent back an SQ and asked for the POC key process: creation, rotation cadence, revoke SLA, and sharing method. POC kicks off Tue.
Priyanka (Solutions Eng): Recommended approach for hosted POC keys: project-scoped keys, short-lived by default. Typical values: 48h for manual tester keys, 7d for automation hooks. We can support 24h-30d depending on customer needs.
Rob (SRE): Quick facts: Console + API + CLI for key ops. Per-key IP allowlist supported. Revocation is immediate via API/Console and triggers an audit entry. Audit retention for hosted POCs is 30 days; enterprise contracts can extend to 90 days.
Priyanka (Solutions Eng): Example CLI (replace values):
```
redwoodctl keys create --project=bluefin-poc --expires-in=48h --ip-allowlist=198.51.100.0/24 --label="bluefin-qa"
```
Lena (Sales): Who performs revocation if the customer requests a kill during the POC?
Rob (SRE): Vendor will perform immediate revoke on request (console/API). Confirmations: webhook/email ack within 30 minutes. If Sales requests, we act immediately.
Security Team: Customer asked whether keys can be rotated automatically from their side. Answer?
Priyanka (Solutions Eng): We support rotating keys via API and can publish short-lived keys to a customer-managed secrets store if they provide a vault endpoint. For full KMS/HSM integration we recommend Private deployment.
Ops Bot (ops-bot): Reminder: never paste raw keys in public channels. Use secure-ticket or DM.
Lena (Sales): Can we limit scope so keys only allow generation endpoints and not admin-level calls?
Rob (SRE): Yes. Keys can be scoped by role: generate, embeddings, and read-only. Admin scopes (key creation/revocation) are separate. For POC we give generate + embeddings only.
Priyanka (Solutions Eng): For the SQ text I'll propose: "We issue project-scoped hosted API keys for POCs. Keys default to short lifetimes (48h) and can include IP allowlists. Revocation is immediate via our API/console; we provide confirmation within 30 minutes. Audit logs are retained for 30 days. For customers needing vault/KMS integration or longer audit retention we recommend Redwood Private."
Security Team: Add: escalation contacts and a single phone number for immediate revokes in the SQ.
Lena (Sales): Noted. Priyanka, can you paste the exact API example for revocation?
Priyanka (Solutions Eng): API revoke example (HTTP): POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke with bearer token. Response 200 and audit record created. I'll add the cURL snippet to the SQ doc.
Rob (SRE): I'll open a short runbook: how Sales requests a revoke, who to CC, and how to verify via audit events.
Ops Bot (ops-bot): action created: TICKET-7002 assigned to Rob (SRE) for runbook + revoke webhook test.
Lena (Sales): Thanks all, going to update the SQ with that wording and include the checklist and contact for 24/7 revokes.
Priyanka (Solutions Eng): I'll DM the secure key generation steps once NDA is confirmed and we'll keep the POC keys in project "bluefin-poc".
Security Team: Good. Also note: for POCs where customer demands no external egress, we flag for Private.
Lena (Sales): Perfect, appreciate it :thumbsup:
